claims.quote: WWOX/WOX1 is a candidate tumor suppressor.
Human WWOX gene, encoding the WW domain-containing oxidoreductase (designated WWOX, FOR, or WOX1) protein
the WW domain is not only a tumor suppressor, but also a participant in molecular interactions, signaling, and apoptosis in many diseases.

claims.object_text: participation in Alzheimer's disease pathogenesis via cell death signaling pathways in neurons
claims.quote: we review the potential mechanism by which WWOX/WOX1 may participate in the pathogenesis of AD with a focus on cell death signaling pathways in neurons.

claims.object_text: mapped to a fragile site on chromosome ch16q23.3-24.1
claims.quote: has been mapped to a fragile site on the chromosome ch16q23.3-24.1.
